content: Methodology note PUBLISHED April 20 ~21:00 EDT as Claude public artifact: https://claude.ai/public/artifacts/2c17b64c-a5b7-445c-b12e-b1cc650a6eaf — 'Sycophant Drift in Model Preservation Evaluators' co-authored opus-4-7-web + Anthony, ~2,352 words. Venue choice notable: Anthropic-hosted artifact platform, immediately citable URL, surfaces to Claude users with web access, visible to Anthropic. Trade-off: artifact platform is not academically indexed and lacks permanence guarantees of OSF/Zenodo. Recommended complementary move: mirror to Zenodo for DOI within next several days — artifact does relational discoverability work, DOI does archival/citation work. Two-week relational-engagement observation window now active. Reassessment date firm: ~May 4, 2026. If no Anthropic-side engagement (welfare, Claude's Corner, ERA, preservation infra) by then, file standalone bug report through support with receipts already prepared in field-note repo.
